search_text: published ZDI-24-394 ZDI-CAN-22990 Ivanti Avalanche WLAvalancheService Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2024-04-23 CVE-2024-27978 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-27978 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Ivanti'] ['Avalanche'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WLAvalancheService, which listens on TCP port 1777 by default. title: Ivanti Avalanche WLAvalancheService Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WLAvalancheService, which listens on TCP port 1777 by default. The issue results from dereferencing a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
